raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers is an SCD2 history table: 230 rows for 200 distinct customers, with 30 historical rows where is_current=false. silver_customers keeps all versions, so the join in gold_region_daily fans out and inflates counts (5251 vs 4558); keeping only the current version, valid from 2025-01-01 and so covering every 2026 transaction, restores one row per customer.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers WHERE is_current QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY valid_from DESC) = 1"}}
